question: In Mesothelioma trials, categorize number of arms as 1-arm, 2-arm, or ≥3-arm.
generated_sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN "Number of arms" = 1 THEN '1-arm'
        WHEN "Number of arms" = 2 THEN '2-arm'
        WHEN "Number of arms" >= 3 THEN '>=3-arm'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "Number of arms category"
FROM compat.clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Mesothelioma'
